privacyPolicy.title: AOSER Policies
privacyPolicy.intro: These policies shall take effect immediately upon your registration as a member or user of Aoser.

sections.title: Section 1: Security & Privacy Policy
paragraphs: Aoser places the highest priority on the security of user data and is committed to strictly protecting personal information in accordance with international standards.
1. Scope of this policy
- This policy applies to the collection, use, disclosure, and protection of personal data from Service Users (Customers) and Service Providers (Freelancers).
2. Data collection and use
- Only essential data will be collected, such as name, phone number, email, photos, location, and identity verification documents.
- Data will be used solely for service-related purposes: identity verification, bookings, coordination, and invoicing.
3. Data protection
- Data encryption is applied to all transactions.
- Information is stored on secure servers with backup systems in place.
- Strict internal access controls are enforced.
- Two-factor authentication (2FA) is required for critical accounts.
4. Data sharing and disclosure
- Aoser will not disclose user data to third parties unless explicit consent is given, required by law/government agencies, or necessary for user safety and security.
5. User rights
- Users can request access, correction, or account deletion at any time.
- Users have the right to file complaints regarding personal data breaches.

sections.title: Section 2: Platform Usage Policy
paragraphs: This policy outlines the rules and standards for using the Aoser platform for both customers and service providers to ensure safety, transparency, and professionalism.
1. Customers - Requirements
- Must register with accurate, verifiable information (e.g., real name, active phone number).
- Illegal use such as human trafficking, gambling, or sexual services is strictly prohibited.
- Fake orders or fraud to exploit service providers is prohibited.
Customers - Violations
- Aoser reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts without prior notice.
- Repeated violations may result in referral to legal authorities.
2. Service Providers (Freelancers) - Requirements
- Must verify identity with documents (Passport, ID card, license, rental contract, etc.).
- Must provide accurate service (real photos/videos, pricing, hours).
- Illegal or immoral services are strictly prohibited.
Service Providers - Violations
- More than 3 poor-quality service reports may lead to temporary suspension.
- Fraud (e.g., bait-and-switch or fake service) will result in permanent account termination.

sections.title: Section 3: Payment & Payout Policy
paragraphs: Aoser is committed to ensuring secure, transparent, and efficient financial transactions for both users and providers.
1. Payment methods
- QR Code
- Mobile Banking
- Credit/Debit Cards
- Supported E-Wallets (domestic)
2. Provider payout conditions
- Payment is released after the service is completed and confirmed by the customer.
- Funds are transferred within 1-2 business days to the provider's registered bank account.
3. Platform fee
- Freelancer: 10% of total service fee.
- Fees are automatically deducted before disbursing payments to providers.
4. Receipts
- An e-Receipt is issued to customers automatically after each transaction.
- Providers can download income reports via the dashboard.

sections.title: Section 4: Quality Assurance & Rating Policy
paragraphs: Aoser promotes transparent review and rating systems to ensure service quality and build user trust.
1. Rating system
- Customers can rate services from 1 to 5 stars after completion.
- Reviews must be respectful and constructive.
- Ratings influence the provider's visibility on the platform.
2. "Top Rated" ranking
- Providers with an average rating of 3.5 stars and above will be listed as "Top Rated."
- Benefits include homepage visibility, priority recommendations, and access to promotional campaigns.
3. Low-quality service handling
- 3+ complaints for poor service or rude behavior will result in a temporary suspension.
- Verified complaints may lead to permanent account termination or reduced visibility.
4. Internal quality monitoring
- Aoser's audit team conducts random monthly checks focusing on posted data/image accuracy, location cleanliness/safety, and provider politeness/punctuality.

sections.title: Section 5: Cancellation & Refund Policy
paragraphs: Aoser implements a fair and flexible cancellation/refund policy to protect both customers and providers while minimizing conflicts.
1. Customer cancellations
- Before provider begins: 100% full refund.
- After partial completion: 50% refund.
- After full completion: no refund (unless service was faulty; refund may be partial).
- Refunds are processed within 3-7 business days via the original payment method.
2. Provider cancellations
- If a provider cancels without valid reason: customer receives a 100% refund.
- Provider credibility score will be reduced and may face temporary suspension.
3. Service not as advertised
- Complaints must be submitted within 48 hours.
- Aoser will investigate and may issue full refunds for misrepresentation or partial refunds for valid damages.
4. Exceptions
- Aoser reserves the right to deny refunds in cases of no-shows without notice, partial service use followed by cancellation, or fraudulent refund claims.

sections.title: Section 6: Support & Dispute Resolution Policy
paragraphs: Aoser is committed to transparent operations and fair problem-solving for all parties involved.
1. Contact support (24/7)
- In-app chat
- Email: aoserasia9@gmail.com
- Telephone (Laos): 020 985 10 959
2. Response times
- General inquiries: within 24 hours.
- Urgent issues (e.g., fraud): within 1-12 hours.
- Complaint resolution: within 5 business days.
3. Complaint process
- User files complaint via app/email.
- Investigation team gathers evidence (photos, chats, etc.).
- Aoser acts as a mediator between parties.
- Solutions may include partial/full refunds, credibility penalties, or account suspensions.
4. Legal dispute resolution
- If mediation fails, users may escalate to relevant legal authorities.
- Aoser will fully cooperate in providing documentation and evidence.

sections.title: Section 7: Terms of Use & Legal Disclaimer
paragraphs: By registering to use Aoser, all customers and providers agree to the following terms and conditions.
1. User rights and restrictions
- Users may access the platform to book or offer services as per defined categories.
- Prohibited uses include illegal/immoral activities and actions that harm Aoser or other users (fake accounts, misleading content, inappropriate material).
2. Aoser liability limitation
- Aoser acts solely as a platform to connect clients with providers.
- Aoser is not liable for actions or errors by users unless directly caused by platform failure.
- All issues must follow the internal complaint process before pursuing legal action.
Note: If payment is made outside the Aoser platform, Aoser will not be liable for any disputes or damages.
3. Intellectual property
- All trademarks, logos, content, and images on Aoser are property of the company.
- Users must not violate third-party copyrights. Violators are solely responsible.
4. Policy amendments
- Aoser reserves the right to amend policies without prior notice.
- Users should regularly review terms to ensure compliance with the latest version.
